limits: 67,108,864 pixels per canvas/asset, 64 layers, 2 GiB combined asset/mask storage; admitted memory can constrain work further. Inputs beyond limits are rejected, never silently reduced.
Full native composite is recomputed after edits. No large-project latency or tiling qualification; viewport limit remains 8 Mi pixels.
Physical density from primary TIFF/EXIF, JPEG JFIF and PNG pHYs. Absent/invalid/unsupported metadata remains absent; no dedicated density parser for other RAW container families.
New files use v2 and require an updated reader. Existing v1 files remain readable with their stored square PPI.
RAW sensor development is embedded in raster pixels; sensor decoder/WB and completed stroke parameters cannot be changed after reopening. RGB recipes, masks and transforms remain editable.
Windows execution and Windows/macOS transfer cycles not performed; full English localization and OS association qualification remain open.
Experimental Vulkan denoiser probe cannot run in this Metal build; private-camera/research tests excluded. The complete verify.sh command was not declared passed; no R/SF gates closed.
resolved_failures: Core Image tests cannot run in the terminal sandbox; native-session executions passed.
Timed ordinary photographic editing test failed during concurrent release compilation; unchanged threshold passed in three isolated runs, including the final source binary.

External photo import compared a filesystem observation token directly with a SHA-256. It now uses the broker-validated identity; five external-source native cases passed. Diagnostic retries now preserve failures instead of automatically retrying them.
Service integration assumed the working corpus held exactly 12 files. It now copies only manifest inputs into a canonical isolated directory; native integration passed.
